images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of HiGLR. (a) The multi-scale architecture and (b) its main block use DSFFN at all scales, BRHA at intermediate resolutions, and dense self-attention at the coarsest scale. (c) DSFFN decouples compact spatial mixing from expanded pointwise transformations. (d) BRHA combines coarse global attention with block-sparse residual attention.
